title: Seller Briefs, Deal Plays, Objection Handlers, and Demo Runbooks for inference-route launch
creator: Asha Patel
description: Create a concise, battle-tested set of enablement artifacts for Sales and Customer Success to accelerate deals and reduce time-to-value for customers adopting the Smart Routing features in runtime-1.18. This ticket covers seller one-pagers, competitive deal plays, objection handling, two demo runbooks (Quick-Start and Deep Ops Troubleshoot), and a CS onboarding checklist. Artifacts will be disseminated via Notion, Slack #sales-ops, and a live enablement session.
objectives: Provide sales with clear value props and 3 battle plays tied to customer scenarios
Equip CS with post-sale onboarding checklist and troubleshooting runbook
Reduce sales ramp time by 25% for launch-period deals
Align messaging with release notes and marketing FAQs
deliverables: Seller one-pager (one page PDF) with 3 verticalized deal plays
Battlecard: competitor matrix + pricing win themes
Objection handler cheat sheet (10 common objections)
Quick-Start demo runbook (5-minute flow) with exact prompts and expected outputs
Deep Ops demo runbook (15-minute flow) showing performance/cost tradeoffs and KV cache behaviors
CS onboarding checklist and handover template
Slide deck for 30-minute enablement + trainer notes
distribution_plan: Primary distribution via Notion enablement space (link placeholder), pinned Slack post in #sales-ops, email digest to AEs and CS leads, and mandatory 30-minute live session scheduled in calendar. Post-launch: upload to enablement S3 bucket and mark in Salesforce enablement tab.
release_notes_coordination: Lead: PM (Asha). Coordinate with ENG release owner (ENG-20234) to extract user-facing bullet points and performance caveats. Prepare a customer-facing summary and a technical appendix for CS. Draft release notes entry to be submitted to marketing by 2025-02-22. Reference PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pulls/3210 and perf dashboard: https://dash.redwood.local/perf/runtime-1.18. Link the final release notes section to the seller one-pager and the battlecard.
